system.story: A patch cable, a spool of solder, a muttered curse - and the wreck rolls again.

target.custom: One ally, machine, drone, vehicle, or piece of gear

effect.after:
Main action (or maneuver for a quick patch), touch or short range, no Uptime cost. Restore Integrity/Stamina equal to your Recovery value (8) toward the cap of 12 to a drone, vehicle, piece of chrome, or gear, clear a mechanical condition (jam, glitch, suppression), or rearm a mount. On Outcome Tier 1, mend more and clear a condition; on Tier 3 the patch is unstable (holds until the next hit).

Enhance - Spend 1 Uptime: repair at range or a second target, or restore a wrecked machine to minimal function for a scene.
